description: The signed-in member's saved Vela layouts (workspaces), newest first: each one's name, id, when it was last saved, whether it has a share link, and its Vela link (chart_url) that opens that layout. Use it when the member asks for their saved charts or layouts or wants one opened. Read only: it cannot save, rename, share or delete a layout. For a single market on a chart, give that market's chart_url instead. Requires signing in with a LuxAlgo account (OAuth).
